decisions.context: Make intent robust without prior snapshot and consistent across menu/CLI; keep offline-friendly behaviour.

decisions.context: Deterministic v1 with no providers; Makefile sanity target; module entry portfolio_exporter.scripts.micro_momo_analyzer.
decisions.decision: CSV-only Micro-MOMO Analyzer landed: filters, weighted scoring, A/B/C tiers, direction, option structure picker (Debit Call / Bear Call Credit), sizing + TP/SL, human-readable triggers; CLI + tests + fixtures; scored/orders CSV outputs.
decisions.title: MICRO_MOMO_V1

decisions.context: CI-safe via offline mode; tests mock providers; CSV precedence respected in enrich mode.
decisions.decision: Live enrichment via IBKR (primary) and Yahoo (fallback) with halts + provenance. Adds --data-mode/--providers/--offline/--halts-source flags; enrichment fills last/prev_close, premarket gap, RVOL(1m/5m), VWAP, ORB, float/ADV/short%, borrow, chain near-money OI/spread, halts_count_today. Provenance src_* columns and data_errors included.
decisions.title: MICRO_MOMO_V1_1

decisions.context: Reduce dependence on external sources by reusing local files and cached provider data; enable quick multi-symbol ad-hoc runs.
decisions.decision: Add --symbols mode to run without a shortlist CSV; implement Yahoo 1m bars and option chains with a local JSON cache; compute RVOL/VWAP/ORB and derive above_vwap_now/pattern; fallback to provider chains when CSV missing; add visible menu symbols prompt and env passthrough.
decisions.title: MICRO_MOMO_SYMBOLS_YAHOO_CACHE

decisions.context: Keep operators local in TR while honoring U.S. RTH/DST; reduce flapping via cooldown+recross; allow controlled post-halt re-arm consistent with primary reopen auction.
decisions.decision: Sentinel aligned to TR-local schedule (ET->TR via zoneinfo), runtime overlay (CLI > ENV > memory > file > defaults), cooldown and VWAP recross gating, post-halt single re-arm with mini-ORB, early-close aware schedule, and dashboard post-halt count.
decisions.title: SENTINEL_TR_LOCAL_OVERLAY_REARM

decisions.decision: Start SSE tailing after the current max event id following the bootstrap snapshot so subsequent events stream monotonically.

decisions.decision: Group semantically identical option combos server-side, emit stable grouping IDs, aggregated greeks/pricing, and provide friendly labels for combos and legs consumed by the UI.
decisions.rationale: Back-end truth avoids duplicate rows, keeps pricing consistent across API/UI, and unlocks the simplified combos table experience.
decisions.title: PSD combos grouping

decisions.decision: Treat missing mark sources as lowest priority so fallback grouping keeps LAST/PREV.
decisions.title: PSD combo mark source

decisions.decision: Use PositionsState.build_fallback_positions_view when upstream positions_view is empty so PSD receives grouped combos and equities.
decisions.rationale: Reports anywhere needing positions_view stay populated without provider support.
decisions.title: PSD fallback view

decisions.decision: Normalize option legs via OSI parsing before grouping so combos always detect and UI labels stay friendly.
decisions.rationale: Backend fills underlying/expiry/right/strike from OSI when provider omits them; frontend sanitizes labels with parseOsi fallback; tests cover ingest + UI.
decisions.title: PSD options OSI fallback
